racial.jorgasianDescription: A proximity scanner.

racial.glitchDescription: Interested. This control system is unfamiliar to me.

racial.glitchDescription: Curious. What will happen if I press this button?

racial.akkimariDescription: Akki press button, things happen. Good things? Exploding things!

racial.glitchDescription: Statement. A switch.
racial.drodenDescription: Analysis. Switch. Used to power on and off various objects.
racial.akkimariDescription: Akki flip switch, make nice noise. Flip, flip, flip again!

racial.hymidDescription: This turret is ever vigilant.

racial.jorgasianDescription: An automated defense turret.

racial.glitchDescription: Statement. A switch.

A fragile rock full of Hyverium ore. Maybe I could break it.

racial.apexDescription: The raw energy flowing through this device is unimaginable...
racial.avianDescription: I have seen powerful Power Crystals, but all of them fade compared to the energy flowing through here.
racial.floranDescription: Floran uncomfortable. Floran afraid of catching fire.
racial.glitchDescription: Uneasy. The raw energy flowing through here could easily melt a whole city.
racial.humanDescription: The amount of energy flowing through here is incredible. It's as if I'm right next to a massive star.
racial.hylotlDescription: Whatever fields are containing this energy are incredibly potent. If the fields failed, this entire place would evaporate in an instant.
racial.novakidDescription: I can feel the primal energy of a star here. It's like it's calling to me...

racial.hymidDescription: The raw energy of a star flows through here. I'm not sure how it's even possible.

racial.jorgasianDescription: The Centens harvested more energy than the entire Alliance combined ever could.
racial.drodenDescription: Detected Old Ones technology. Energy readings spiking. Hazard levels increasing. System anomolies detected.

missing.description: An ancient forge powered by strange energy. Perhaps it can reforge my lost equipment.

racial.apexDescription: This ancient construct looks like a forge. Perhaps I can forge some unique items here.
racial.avianDescription: An ancient forge, powered by strange energies. I can see weapons and other equipment in the hologram.
racial.floranDescription: If Floran losesss itemss, Floran go back here. Floran remake itemsss!
racial.glitchDescription: Amazed. This construct seems to be able to reconstruct lost items.
racial.humanDescription: An ancient forge, with familair-looking items on the hologram. Perhaps I can reforge my equipment here?
racial.hylotlDescription: A mysterious forge powered by unknown means. It seems to be able to reforge lost equipment.
racial.novakidDescription: A star forge built eons ago. I might be able to reforge lost guns here.
racial.aegiDescription: This construct feels familar somehow. The items on the hologram are all items I've seen before.
racial.avikanDescription: A forge left behind by the Old Ones. It seems to have memorized some of the items I have lost.
racial.draunaarDescription: I think it's a forge of some kind. Perhaps I can reforge my equipment here.
racial.trinkDescription: This Centensian construct pulses with energy. The hologram displays familiar items.
racial.hymidDescription: This must be a forge! I think I can reforge lost items here.
racial.notixDescription: The energy that flows through here makes a painfully loud noise. It's like nothing I've ever heard before.
racial.jorgasianDescription: The energy that flows through here resonates with some of my equipment. I think I could retrieve lost items here.
racial.drodenDescription: Analysis complete. Centensian construct. Energy may be used to reforge lost items of power.
racial.akkimariDescription: Akki feel the energy, like sky-sun. Akki recognize pictures-holographic!

missing.description: An ancient construct overflowing with energy. Perhaps my equipment can be strengthened here.

racial.apexDescription: This construct is overflowing with energy. Maybe I can strengthen my equipment here.
racial.avianDescription: This almost looks like an ancient alien altar. Some of my equipment seems to pulse as I come closer.
racial.glitchDescription: Compelled. Something about this construct draws me closer...
racial.humanDescription: Some of my equipment is starting to pulsate. It's like this construct is resonating with my gear.
racial.hylotlDescription: This mysterious construct overflows with energy. My equipment starts to pulsate as I come closer...
racial.novakidDescription: Like some kinda star forge, I bet that this construct can strengthen my equipment.
racial.aegiDescription: Some of my gear is starting to pulsate, as though this construct is calling to it.
racial.avikanDescription: An ancient construct left behind by the Old Ones. Some of my powerful equipment is resonating with its energy.
racial.draunaarDescription: It's like this construct is resonating with some of my weapons. I should investigate.
racial.trinkDescription: The energy of this Centensian construct is resonating with some of my equipment.
racial.hymidDescription: This construct is overflowing with energy, and my equipment is starting to resonate with it...
racial.notixDescription: The hum produced by this construct is almost painful. There must be a lot of energy flowing through here.
racial.jorgasianDescription: The energy flowing through this construct is resonating with some of my equipment.
racial.drodenDescription: Analysis complete. Centensian construct. Energy may be used to strengthen specific equipment.
racial.akkimariDescription: Energy-strange flowing here. Weapons-Akki resonate. Bathe them in the light?

missing.description: An ancient artefact, created by the Centens.

racial.apexDescription: A perfect cube levitating above a pedestal. What might this be?
racial.avianDescription: An artefact of ancient times, no doubt.
racial.glitchDescription: Intrigued. This appears to be a truly ancient artefact.
racial.humanDescription: A spinning, levitating cube above some sort of pedestal. Is it valuable?
racial.hylotlDescription: A mysterious cube. It feels like it's been here for eons.
racial.novakidDescription: A weird cube floatin' 'bove some sorta pedestal.

racial.avikanDescription: An artefact left behind by the Old Ones. I should make sure it doesn't fall into the hands of the Thell.
racial.draunaarDescription: An artefact of the Centens, no doubt.
racial.trinkDescription: A Centensian artefact. Its purpose is unknown.
racial.hymidDescription: An artefact of the Gods. What it is exactly is a mystery to me.
racial.notixDescription: A Centensian artefact. I feel an odd sensation when I get close to it.
racial.jorgasianDescription: An artefact, most likely created by the Centens.
racial.drodenDescription: Detected Centensian artefact. Recommend immediate extraction by Nomada salvage crew.

missing.description: A massive column.

racial.apexDescription: A large metal column. Or is it a pillar?
racial.avianDescription: A massive, ancient column. It's incredible that it's still standing.
racial.floranDescription: Floran can't break thisss metal. Floran mad.
racial.glitchDescription: Fascinated. My readings indicate that this column has stood here for tens of thousands of years, maybe more.
racial.humanDescription: Now THAT's a column!
racial.hylotlDescription: Columns are common in many forms of alien architecture. They present an image of strength and serenity.
racial.novakidDescription: That's quite the column.
racial.aegiDescription: A Centensian-built column. It's quite massive.
racial.avikanDescription: The Old Ones built many impressive structures.
racial.draunaarDescription: I have always loved columns in architecture.
racial.trinkDescription: A large column. These are often used for support, but given that the Centens built it, it likely only serves as decoration.
racial.hymidDescription: A massive column fit for the gods.
racial.notixDescription: A large column. It can support a heavy weight.
racial.jorgasianDescription: Columns almost always look good.
racial.drodenDescription: Detected Centensian column.

missing.description: A simplistic metal cube, but with an enthralling aura.

racial.apexDescription: A simple metal cube, but there's something enthralling about it.
racial.avianDescription: There is something oddly enthralling about this cube.
racial.floranDescription: Floran sstaress at cube. Floran doess not know why...
racial.glitchDescription: Enthralled. This cube has something mysterious to it.
racial.humanDescription: I don't know why, but I'm finding it hard to get my eyes off this cube.
racial.hylotlDescription: Somehow, this cube makes me feel serene. It's enthralling.
racial.novakidDescription: I'm oddly enthralled by this simple cube... What is this magic?
racial.aegiDescription: A cube, built by the Centens. It is oddly enthralling...
racial.avikanDescription: This artefact of the Old Ones is enthralling. I just keep staring at it.
racial.draunaarDescription: I can't say why, but this cube is incredibly enthralling...
racial.trinkDescription: My systems are picking up an odd interference around this cube.
racial.hymidDescription: This relic of the Gods is enthralling. I just want to stare at it.
racial.notixDescription: I feel something odd when near this cube. It is enthralling, somehow.
racial.jorgasianDescription: I don't know why, but all I want to do is stare at this cube...

missing.description: A massive floating cube.

racial.apexDescription: A massive cube, floating just above the ground. What keeps it in place?
racial.avianDescription: A massive cube, held aloft by invisible wings. It is... beautiful!
racial.floranDescription: Floran doesss not undersstand how masssive cube can fly.
racial.glitchDescription: Baffled. This cube must weigh more than a house, yet it stays aloft somehow.
racial.humanDescription: A massive metal cube, untouched by time. What keeps it aloft?
racial.hylotlDescription: Mystery surrounds this cube. It is magnificent.
racial.novakidDescription: It goes 'round and 'round and 'round... Makes my head spin, it does.
racial.aegiDescription: How the Centens managed to build artefacts like these is beyond me.

racial.draunaarDescription: Some sort of massive Centensian cube. It hovers above the ground, somehow.
racial.trinkDescription: Whatever mechanism keeps this cube aloft must be extremely efficient.
racial.hymidDescription: This cube was built by the Gods, for a purpose beyond my ken.
racial.notixDescription: This cube resonates with a strange power. It is comforting, somehow.
racial.jorgasianDescription: A Centensian artefact. Mysterious, as always.
racial.drodenDescription: Detected Centensian artefact. Marking location for Rhaiod investigation.
racial.akkimariDescription: Cube-large-floating, Akki wonder how it works.

missing.description: A conduit through which concentrated jumpfire is conducted.

racial.apexDescription: The heat radiating from this conduit is unbearable.
racial.avianDescription: I feel like I'm flying too close to the sun. The heat is incredible.
racial.floranDescription: Floran feeling too hot. Floran fearsss ssspontaneous combusstion...
racial.glitchDescription: Cautious. The heat radiating from this conduit is almost dangerous.
racial.humanDescription: The heat here is almost unbearable.
racial.hylotlDescription: I shouldn't stay here long. This conduit is far too hot for me.
racial.novakidDescription: This feels like raw solar energy.
racial.aegiDescription: This conduit is conducting solar energy. The radiation is weakened by containment fields, but the heat is still almost unbearable.
racial.avikanDescription: The Old Ones harvested stars with ease. Solar energy flows through this conduit.
racial.draunaarDescription: TODO
racial.trinkDescription: The Centens harvested stars for energy. This conduit is conducting solar energy.
racial.hymidDescription: I could use a drink. This conduit is radiating so much heat that I feel like I'm drying up.
racial.notixDescription: The heat radiated by this conduit is unbearable.
racial.jorgasianDescription: Solar energy flows through this conduit. The containment fields are keeping it contained, but I shouldn't try touching it.
racial.drodenDescription: Warning. Heat levels rising. Diverting power to cooling systems...
racial.akkimariDescription: Akki wish Akki could harvest energy-all. Akki could defeat god-thieves.

racial.apexDescription: This statue depicts an alien warrior of sorts.
racial.avianDescription: A shining statue of an alien warrior.
racial.glitchDescription: Fascination. This statue is ancient, yet still in pristine condition.
racial.humanDescription: This statue is beautiful! I wish I had a sword like that...
racial.hylotlDescription: This statue is fascinating. The craftsmanship is unparalelled.
racial.novakidDescription: This 'ere statue looks right old!
racial.aegiDescription: A fascinating statue indeed! These Centensian relics always have an air of mystery to me!
racial.avikanDescription: A statue left behind by the Old Ones. It is beautiful, like all of their relics.
racial.draunaarDescription: This statue depicts an ancient Centensian warrior. It's superbly crafted.
racial.trinkDescription: This statue depicts a Ce'tennan, or Centens - both names apply.
racial.hymidDescription: A statue of one of the Gods, no doubt, and created by them as well.
racial.notixDescription: The Centens were fond of swords, despite their unparalleled advancements in firearm technologies.
racial.jorgasianDescription: A wonderfully crafted statue of a Centens.
racial.drodenDescription: Analyzing statue. Detected Centensian craftsmanship.
racial.akkimariDescription: God-maker statue, sword-large. Akki want to take sword!

racial.glitchDescription: Cautious. This monolith is somehow interfering with my sensors.
racial.humanDescription: A monolith of sorts. Why does it make me feel so odd?
racial.hylotlDescription: A monolith made of an unknown metal - how mysterious!
racial.novakidDescription: That's a fine monolith right there.
racial.aegiDescription: A Centensian monolith. We never managed to figure out the purpose of these slabs.

racial.jorgasianDescription: A monolith. The Centens left behind many strange relics such as these.
